resources.description: Documentation for AI agents and developers: agent surfaces, public API, MCP server, authentication, and example requests.
Machine-readable overview of the site: what it is, coverage, and key pages.
How agents obtain credentials: none needed for public read-only content or the public API; website sign-up for listing owners.
Listing tiers in plain markdown: Basic PKR 99, Premium PKR 199, Featured PKR 299, one-time. The read-only API is free with no key.
Markdown twin of the homepage: what the site is, coverage, and how to find or list a business.
Read-only JSON API: search businesses, read one business, list categories and cities. Free, no key, 60 requests/minute per IP. Documented in OpenAPI at /openapi.json.
OpenAPI 3.1 document for the public read-only API: operations, parameters, and response schemas.
Streamable HTTP MCP server (POST /api/mcp) with read-only tools: search_businesses, get_business, list_categories, list_cities. Server card at /.well-known/mcp/server-card.json.
MCP server card: display name, description, endpoint, and tool list.
RFC 9728 metadata: scopes listings:read (public) and listings:write (website-only); no authorization server, no bearer tokens issued.
RFC 8414 metadata stating honestly that PakListings has no OAuth authorization server: Firebase email/password website sign-in only, no token endpoint.
XML sitemap of the site's indexable public pages.
